items.informal_name: Coefficient of Taylor Expansion at $ r $: $ \text{coeff}_n(f(X + r)) = D^{(n)}f(r) $
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $, natural number $ n $, and element $ r \in R $, the coefficient of $ X^n $ in the Taylor expansion $ f(X + r) $ equals the evaluation of the $ n $-th Hasse derivative of $ f $ at $ r $. The Hasse derivative $ D^{(n)} $ scales monomials $ a_i X^i $ by $ \binom{i}{n} a_i X^{i - n} $.

items.informal_name: First Coefficient of Taylor Expansion Equals Derivative
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff 1 = Polynomial.eval r (Polynomial.derivative f)
items.informal_description: The coefficient of $ X $ in the Taylor expansion of a polynomial $ f $ at a point $ r $ in a semiring $ R $ is equal to the derivative of $ f $ evaluated at $ r $, i.e., $ \text{coeff}_1(\text{Taylor}_r(f)) = f'(r) $.

items.type: {E : Type u_2} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℕ → Set ℝ → ℝ → E
items.informal_description: For a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $, a natural number $ k $, a set $ s \subseteq \mathbb{R} $, and a point $ x_0 \in \mathbb{R} $, the Taylor coefficient of order $ k $ within $ s $ at $ x_0 $ is defined as $ \frac{1}{k!} $ multiplied by the $ k $-th iterated derivative of $ f $ (restricted to $ s $) evaluated at $ x_0 $. This represents the scaled $ k $-th derivative contribution to the Taylor expansion of $ f $ at $ x_0 $ within the domain $ s $.

items.type:
{E : Type u_2} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℕ → Set ℝ → ℝ → PolynomialModule ℝ E
items.informal_description: For a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $, natural number $ n $, subset $ s \subseteq \mathbb{R} $, and point $ x_0 \in \mathbb{R} $, the Taylor polynomial of degree $ n $ within $ s $ at $ x_0 $ is defined as the finite sum $ \sum_{k=0}^n \left(\frac{f^{(k)}(x_0)}{k!} \cdot (X - x_0)^k\right) $, where each coefficient $ \frac{f^{(k)}(x_0)}{k!} $ is computed using the $ k $-th iterated derivative of $ f $ restricted to $ s $. This represents the polynomial approximation of $ f $ near $ x_0 $ within the domain $ s $.

items.informal_name: Factorial Scaling Identity for k-th Derivatives of Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (A : Type u_3) [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (p : Polynomial R)
  (q : ℕ) {k : ℕ},
  q ≤ k →
    ∃ gp,
      gp.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - k ∧
        ∀ (r : A), (Polynomial.aeval r) ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p) = q.factorial • (Polynomial.aeval r) gp
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p \in R[X] $, natural numbers $ q $ and $ k $ with $ q \leq k $, there exists a polynomial $ g_p $ with $ \deg(g_p) \leq \deg(p) - k $ such that for every $ r \in A $, the evaluation of the $ k $-th derivative of $ p $ at $ r $ equals $ q! \cdot \text{aeval}_r(g_p) $.

items.informal_name: Successor Taylor Polynomial Within a Set
items.type:
∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : ℝ → E) (n : ℕ) (s : Set ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ),
  taylorWithin f (n + 1) s x₀ =
    taylorWithin f n s x₀ +
      (PolynomialModule.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x₀))
        ((PolynomialModule.single ℝ (n + 1)) (taylorCoeffWithin f (n + 1) s x₀))
items.informal_description: For a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $, natural number $ n $, subset $ s \subseteq \mathbb{R} $, and point $ x_0 \in \mathbb{R} $, the Taylor polynomial of degree $ n+1 $ within $ s $ at $ x_0 $ is equal to the Taylor polynomial of degree $ n $ plus the term $ \frac{f^{(n+1)}(x_0)}{(n+1)!} \cdot (X - x_0)^{n+1} $. This expresses the recursive construction of Taylor polynomials by adding the next-order term involving the $(n+1)$-th derivative.

items.informal_name: Coefficient of Natural Degree in Taylor Expansion Equals Leading Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff f.natDegree = f.leadingCoeff
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ and an element $ r \in R $, the coefficient of the natural degree term in the Taylor expansion of $ f $ at $ r $ (i.e., the polynomial $ f(X + r) $) is equal to the leading coefficient of $ f $. This holds because the highest-degree term in $ f(X + r) $ retains the leading coefficient of $ f $ after binomial expansion.

items.informal_name: Derivative of Taylor Series Terms for Functions with Finite Taylor Expansions
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {E : Type uE} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {F : Type uF} [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {n : WithTop ℕ∞}
  {f : E → F} {p : E → FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F},
  HasFTaylorSeriesUpTo n f p → ∀ (m : ℕ), ↑m < n → ∀ (x : E), HasFDerivAt (fun y => p y m) (p x m.succ).curryLeft x
items.informal_description: If a function $ f $ has a Taylor series expansion up to order $ n $ given by a formal multilinear series $ p $, then for every natural number $ m $ less than $ n $, the derivative of the $ m $-th term of the series at any point $ x $ is equal to the $ (m+1) $-th term of the series evaluated at $ x $ with the first argument curried. This holds in the context of a non-trivially normed field $ \mathbb{K} $, normed vector spaces $ E $ and $ F $ over $ \mathbb{K} $, and an extended natural number $ n $.
